scope: Live parsed TypeAnnotation metadata to the exact CSharp parser spelling used by PublicInterfaceFields.
decisions: Preserve canonical punctuation spacing, decimal array/BitSet extents and product trailing-comma normalization. Resolve explicit aliases before parser builtin/active generic/associated names; retain full qualified paths and qualify local nominal names by parsed namespace. Use exact parsed import targets and reject ambiguous open names. Source ownership stays in PackageAnalysis; returned fields own their bytes.
limitations: Type field discovery is a representation adapter, not whole interface/cache integration. Complete function/trait declaration fact projection remains separate.
sourceContext: The PackageAnalysis remains a readonly input. TypeFieldContext owns the already-derived identity/import arrays once and carries source/owner coordinates; no cloned source owner or temporary reference-storage aggregate is introduced.
coveredFacts: Six loaded files: exact20 type spellings, explicit/open imports, same-namespace sibling declaration shadowing, active generic parameters and trait-associated types, plus13 canonical container/reference forms.
